title: Kernel presentation from the filtration
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and n a natural number. Assume that for every R-module N in universe v and every exhaustive monotone well-ordered filtration indexed in universe w, bounds n on the successive quotient projective resolutions imply a bound n on the resolution of N [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension]. Let M have such a filtration F whose successive quotients instead have bounds n+1. Then there exists a short exact sequence K → P → M in ModuleCat.{v} R with P categorical-projective and K admitting a projective resolution of length at most n.

proof.text: Choose the supplied length-n+1 projective resolutions of the stage quotients inside this proof. Apply the kernel-filtration construction to this family, obtaining S with third term M, short exactness, projective middle term, and an exhaustive monotone filtration G of S.X₁. At each index its quotient is zero or isomorphic to the chosen augmentation kernel.

At a zero kernel quotient use the identity resolution of the zero object. Otherwise truncate the chosen quotient resolution by the augmentation-kernel theorem, then transport the resulting bounded resolution through the given isomorphism by composing its augmentation with the inverse isomorphism.

Apply hIH to S.X₁, G, its monotonicity and exhaustion, and the bounds n on every successive quotient just proved. Combine the resulting bound on S.X₁ with the short exactness and projective middle term already obtained.

proof_origin.place: Algebra, Lemma 0D1U, successor proof; use the supplied quotient presentations and truncate their resolutions, avoiding Schanuel and unrestricted enough projectives

theorem exists_shortExact_projective_middle_of_wellOrderedUnion_succ
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (hIH : ∀ (M : ModuleCat.{v} R) {E : Type w} [LinearOrder E]
      [IsWellOrder E (· < ·)] (F : E → Submodule R M) (hF : Monotone F)
      (hcover : ∀ x : M, ∃ e : E, x ∈ F e)
      (hquot : ∀ e : E, HasProjectiveResolutionLE
        (ModuleCat.of R ((F e) ⧸
          ((⨆ e' : {i : E // i < e}, F e'.val).comap (F e).subtype))) n),
      HasProjectiveResolutionLE M n)
    (M : ModuleCat.{v} R) {E : Type w} [LinearOrder E]
    [IsWellOrder E (· < ·)] (F : E → Submodule R M) (hF : Monotone F)
    (hcover : ∀ x : M, ∃ e : E, x ∈ F e)
    (hquot : ∀ e : E, HasProjectiveResolutionLE
      (ModuleCat.of R ((F e) ⧸
        ((⨆ e' : {i : E // i < e}, F e'.val).comap (F e).subtype))) (n + 1)) :
    ∃ S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R), S.X₃ = M ∧ S.ShortExact ∧
      Projective S.X₂ ∧ HasProjectiveResolutionLE S.X₁ n
